memory_candidates.content: zotero-cli-cc (command: zot) is the recommended shell-first Zotero backend for Claude Code agents. Install via: uv tool install zotero-cli-cc. The Zotero data directory is auto-detected as ~/Zotero on Linux; if stored at ~/Documents/Zotero/ (or another path), set ZOT_DATA_DIR env var. Read operations (search, PDF, notes, tags) work offline via SQLite with no auth. Write operations (notes, attachments) require a Zotero Web API key set up via `zot config init`. The stable JSON envelope {ok, data, meta} is auto-enabled when stdout is non-TTY. Child attachments are created with: zot attach KEY --file chunk.md (and --dry-run / --idempotency-key for safe agent use). Version 0.7.0 was tested and installed cleanly on NixOS with uv 0.11.19.

On NixOS, Python CLI tools not in nixpkgs can be installed via `uv tool install <package>`. The tool is placed in ~/.local/bin/ which is NOT on PATH by default. Requires either: (1) export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" in shell profile, or (2) environment.localBinInPath = true in NixOS system config, or (3) home.sessionVariables.PATH = "$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" in home-manager. The ZOT_DATA_DIR env var pattern (tool-specific env var for data directory override) is a clean way to handle non-default data paths without modifying config files.
